answer: A new identity spends its first 8 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 25% of full weight. Because the sonnet weight is recomputed from the gale history each close, the garden audit makes public the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for each extra identity, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
